# Method GetPdmMinorRevision

#### GetPdmMinorRevision(DocumentId)

Gets the PDM minor revision corresponding to a document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
PdmMinorRevisionId GetPdmMinorRevision(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  PdmMinorRevisionId |  Identifier of the corresponding PDM minor revision.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
